title: A faithfully flat ring map is surjective on spectra
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a faithfully flat homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]. Then the induced map of prime spectra $\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, $\mathfrak q\mapsto\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$, is surjective: for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset R$ there is a prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset S$ with $\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)=\mathfrak p$.
